about: Eleven stored readings of one tier-7 account over two days in which it bought the Starter and Epic packs, cut down to what the coin planning tools read. Each reading is a snapshot of SDK reader output. The newest carries the thirty runs its save held; each earlier one carries only the runs that have since dropped out. Numbers are rounded to seven significant digits. Each run keeps its coin counters, its kill count by enemy type and how many enemies died inside each coin window. No player name or id is kept; the only balances kept are coins and cells.
